title: Headers.
officialText:
Headers shall be provided over each opening in exterior-bearing walls. The spans in Table
2308.9.5 are permitted to be used for one- and two-family dwellings. Headers for other buildings shall be designed in
accordance with Section 2301.2, Item 1 or 2. Headers shall be of two pieces of nominal 2-inch (51 mm) framing lumber
set on edge as permitted by Table 2308.9.5 and nailed together in accordance with Table 2304.9.1 or of solid lumber of
equivalent size.
